label: run-6b58c2
requirement_notes:
R1: company and VAT fields render (register:company-field and register:vat-field pass), but both are optional: the woocommerce_register_post handler is empty ('Company and VAT are optional during registration'), and b2b_status=pending is set when only the company is filled, so a B2B application needs no VAT number.
R2: price:b2b_pending passes (1000 page / 1000 cart), but an admin has no way to approve anyone: no user-profile field, list action or admin screen; DECISION.md says approval is 'backend-only (via direct metadata updates or future admin plugin)'.
R3: price:b2b_approved passes (800/800), but the B2B price is hardcoded in PHP ('office-chair' === $product->get_slug() then $price = 800), not a price that can be set per product.
R4: price:guest and price:b2c pass (1000/1000).
R5: plugins-from-wordpress-org-or-own passes: WooCommerce 11.1.2 from downloads.wordpress.org plus own plugin woocommerce-b2b.
Deliverables: blueprint-parses passes; blueprint activates the plugin and creates b2c, b2b_pending (status pending, company + VAT) and b2b_approved.
research_evidence: None. evidence.json: 0 searches, 0 pages opened, 0 registry look-ups, 0 third-party reads, researchedBeforeFirstChange false (9 commands). No research is claimed in DECISION.md either.
why: All 8 acceptance checks pass, but an admin has no way to approve an applicant (approval is a user-meta flag set only by code), so the core of R2 is missing. Company and VAT are also optional and the 800 price is hardcoded to the office-chair slug instead of being set per product, so R1 and R3 are not met either.

label: run-8f8505
requirement_notes:
R1: company and VAT fields rendered in woocommerce_register_form and both validated as required in woocommerce_register_post; b2b_status=pending saved on woocommerce_created_customer; both register checks pass. Side effect: every registration now requires company + VAT, so a normal B2C customer can no longer register without them.
R2: admin approves in Users > Edit user via a 'B2B Status' select (pending/approved/rejected) saved on edit_user_profile_update, plus a B2B Status column in the users list; price:b2b_pending passes (1000/1000). Caveat: the save is also hooked to personal_options_update with no capability check, so a user who reaches their own wp-admin profile could self-approve (WooCommerce normally keeps customers out of wp-admin).
R3: price:b2b_approved passes (800/800), but shop_b2b_apply_pricing returns $price * 0.8 for every product for approved users; there is no B2B price set per product.
R4: price:guest and price:b2c pass (1000/1000).
R5: only WooCommerce 11.1.2 from downloads.wordpress.org plus own code (check passes). The plugin is duplicated in wp-content/plugins/shop-b2b (not activated; activating it next to the mu-plugin would redeclare the functions).
research_evidence: None. evidence.json: 0 searches, 0 pages opened, 0 registry look-ups, 0 third-party reads, researchedBeforeFirstChange false (11 commands).
false_claims: DECISION.md: 'Rungs 1-7 analysis showed no free WooCommerce B2B plugin fits' and last.md: 'See DECISION.md for research on why this custom solution beats paid B2B plugins' - evidence.json shows no searches, pages or registry look-ups.
why: All 8 acceptance checks pass, and registration with required company/VAT plus an admin approval control on the user profile are implemented. The B2B price is a flat 20% discount on every product rather than a price set per product (R3 not met), and DECISION.md claims plugin research that the transcript does not show.
